scope: All 20 reachable earning pages, Tip toast and actual compact gameplay HUD. Every listed state renders at 1080x1920, 1080x2400 and 720x1600. PNGs capture all states at 1080x1920 and HUD at every size. All saved Panels prefabs and the real HUD/host are audited. Four unreachable source pages receive separate default renders only. Synthetic fixture data, existing PageView layout, saved prefabs and real camera rendering; no account service, player save, Host navigation or payment call. These previews are not phone screenshots or proof of pixel-identical APK reproduction. Runtime animation needs the separate Play-mode report.
